title: Reference-anchored diagnostics of single-cell geometry and native allocation coherence
description: Calibration, chance correction and sensitivity analysis of reference-anchored graph geometry and native probability-allocation diagnostics for single-cell representations. The release contains the manuscript, twelve vector figures, analysis code, synthetic calibration arrays, saved score tables, the matched representation and reference arrays of 24 stored objects, seven tissue sections and one blood sample, the identity-explicit scorer with its decimal-oracle validation, and a consistency audit of the manuscript against the saved evidence. Count matrices of the cited public datasets, complete expression caches and the historical multi-library calibration driver are not distributed.
notes: Mixed-license release: author-owned software MIT; author-owned manuscript, figures and generated results CC BY 4.0; third-party original terms retained. See LICENSE and NOTICE.md. Version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23301675; concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22914408 (resolves to the latest version).
